scenario.title: 201455 TRUIST-Retain Pagination State When Returning to Legacy Reports List - Verify page number and page size are retained after Delete action
scenario.scenarioTitle: 207438: 201455 TRUIST-Retain Pagination State When Returning to Legacy Reports List - Verify page number and page size are retained after Delete action
lookupTokens: 201455 TRUIST-Retain Pagination State When Returning to Legacy Reports List - Verify page number and page size are retained after Delete action

manualSteps.action: Click on Reports and select Legacy Reports.
manualSteps.expected: Legacy Reports list view opens and the available reports are displayed.

manualSteps.action: Select a page size that still leaves more than one page of results. Example: 25.
manualSteps.expected: Selected page size is applied and pagination beyond page 1 remains available.

manualSteps.action: Navigate to page 2 in Legacy Reports list.
manualSteps.expected: Page 2 is displayed with the selected page size.

manualSteps.action: Click Actions for any report and select Delete.

manualSteps.expected: Selected report is deleted successfully and Legacy Reports list returns.

manualSteps.action: Verify the Legacy Reports list retains page 2 and the selected page size after the Delete action.
manualSteps.expected: Legacy Reports list remains on page 2 with the selected page size retained after completing the Delete action.
